themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints surged to 121 in the past week versus a baseline average of 53.5 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 126% increase (z-score: 5.55)—signaling a potential sanitation crisis emerging this week in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights.
evidence: 121 unsanitary condition complaints last week vs. 53.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
126% spike with z-score of 5.55—highest statistical severity among all spikes
Unsanitary condition is #4 complaint type overall (776 over 90 days), now accelerating sharply
reporting_angles: Investigate specific blocks or neighborhoods experiencing the spike—is this concentrated or district-wide?
Interview residents and sanitation workers about whether trash collection has declined or if illegal dumping is contributing (illegal dumping also up 150% two weeks ago)

themes_detail.label: Graffiti and Vandalism Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints skyrocketed 405% to 12 complaints last week compared to a 2.4 complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.68), the second-highest statistical spike, suggesting a sudden vandalism problem emerging this week.
evidence: 12 graffiti complaints last week vs. 2.4 weekly average (405% increase)
Z-score of 4.68—second-highest severity spike in the district
No prior mention in community board or news data, indicating new emergence
reporting_angles: Canvass neighborhoods to map where graffiti concentrations are worst
Interview NYPD and Parks Dept about whether this is organized or reactive vandalism; connect to potential gang activity or enforcement gaps

themes_detail.label: Traffic and Street Congestion Surge
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints jumped 409% to 7 complaints last week from a 1.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.62), indicating a sudden street management or congestion crisis emerging this week in the district.
evidence: 7 traffic complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average (409% increase, z-score: 4.62)
Coincides with active development: 501 DOB building permits filed, including 13 demolitions and 102 new buildings, which may be causing street disruptions
reporting_angles: Cross-reference traffic spike with DOB permit activity and construction sites—are permits causing congestion?
Check for special events, transit changes, or street closures that occurred this week in Crown Heights

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints nearly doubled, rising 132% to 49 complaints last week versus a 21.1 weekly average (z-score: 3.96), reflecting a sudden surge in commercial activity disruption or enforcement gap this week.
evidence: 49 commercial noise complaints last week vs. 21.1 weekly average (132% increase, z-score: 3.96)
Commercial noise is separate from residential noise (1,156 complaints over 90 days), indicating concentrated business-related issue
Complements outdoor dining spike (1,100% up 2 weeks ago), suggesting hospitality sector may be driving noise
reporting_angles: Identify which neighborhoods or commercial corridors are generating noise—Atlantic Ave, Nostrand Ave?
Interview neighbors and business owners about whether new venues, expanded outdoor seating, or late-night operations are the cause

themes_detail.label: Safety Complaints and Flooring Hazards Rise
themes_detail.summary: Safety complaints increased 94% to 15 last week (vs. 7.8 average) and flooring/stairs complaints jumped 125% to 34 (vs. 15.1 average), both emerging this week with z-scores above 3.6, suggesting acute building and street hazard concerns.
evidence: Safety complaints: 15 last week vs. 7.8 average (94% increase, z-score: 3.65)
Flooring/stairs complaints: 34 last week vs. 15.1 average (125% increase, z-score: 3.64)
Community board has repeatedly requested additional building inspectors (unsolved recurring request), suggesting structural oversight gaps may be acute
reporting_angles: Request DOB inspection data to identify which buildings are generating safety and structural complaints
Investigate whether heavy recent construction (501 permits filed) is destabilizing adjacent buildings or creating pedestrian hazards
